info.title: API.SH: Jumia
info.description: The Jumia API from API.SH: public Jumia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Jumia product's verified ratings and reviews: average, count, star breakdown and review texts with rating, title, author, date and variation, with paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jumia-reviews

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product SKU instead of url (with country).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jumia search or category listing (Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Morocco, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Uganda, Senegal, Tunisia, Algeria): SKU, name, brand, link, price, old price, discount, rating and count, categories, seller, sponsored and Express flags, badges and images, with price range, rating, Express and tag filters, sort and paging, plus every filter with options. Also filter by brand, size, colour, minimum discount and minimum seller score (values as listed in `filters`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jumia-search

parameters.name: express
parameters.description: true for Jumia Express items only.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Campaign or store tag, e.g. JMALL (official stores).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: One brand slug, e.g. adidas or samsung (the brand filter's option value, with or without its numeric prefix). Works with q or a one-level category; alone it lists the brand's catalog.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size value(s) from the size filter, comma-separated, e.g. 42 or 42,43.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour name(s) from the colour filter (color_family), comma-separated, e.g. Black,Blue.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Apple IPhone 12 Pro Max 5G - 6.7" (256GB/6GB) + Powerbank - Silver

get.description:
A Jumia seller: id, name, links, seller score, followers, time selling on Jumia, successful sales, performance ratings (shipping speed, quality, customer rating, cancellation rate), recent customer reviews (rating, date, title, comment, author, verified, product) and the seller's products (price, discount, rating, stock, images, link) with sort and paging. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jumia-seller

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Seller slug instead of url (with country).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Jumia country: ng (default), ke, eg, ma, gh, ci, ug, sn, tn, dz.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jumia-suggest

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Jumia country: ng (default), ke, eg, ma, gh, ci, ug, sn, tn, dz.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
